ms.report:
A. Output: SDK and integration scripts for wallet / off-ramp apps
Acceptance criteria: A reusable, non-custodial SDK exposing the four off-ramp primitives (initiateOffRamp, generateZKProof, submitPayment, confirmSettlement) plus integration scripts that wallets and off-ramp apps can call without implementing escrow, ZK, or payment-rail logic themselves.
Evidence:
SDK source — https://github.com/Nucastio/MidnightZK-Off-Ramp-SDK-ADA-Web2-Payments/tree/main/sdk/src
Public API surface — https://github.com/Nucastio/MidnightZK-Off-Ramp-SDK-ADA-Web2-Payments/blob/main/sdk/src/sdk.ts
Integration scripts (Preprod lock / refund / release runners, internal-test harness) — https://github.com/Nucastio/MidnightZK-Off-Ramp-SDK-ADA-Web2-Payments/tree/main/scripts
Commit history showing iterative SDK development — https://github.com/Nucastio/MidnightZK-Off-Ramp-SDK-ADA-Web2-Payments/commits/main

B. Output: ZKP-based payee privacy mechanism
Acceptance criteria: The ZK mechanism successfully generates, verifies, and validates proofs that bind payee data (rail handle, fiat amount, jurisdiction predicate) without exposing the sensitive values on-chain. Five Midnight Compact circuits (bindOffRampIntent, provePayeeBinding, proveAmountBinding, proveComplianceFlag, proveOffRampSettlement) compile to real zk-SNARK proving/verification keys and execute end-to-end against a Midnight node.
Evidence:

Compiled circuit + proving/verification keys — https://github.com/Nucastio/MidnightZK-Off-Ramp-SDK-ADA-Web2-Payments/tree/main/contract/src/managed/offramp
